compatibility: backward-compatible additive revision of checkpoint version 1 with fail-closed live governing-Issue and PR/branch task liveness policy

reference.note: The structural checkpoint version remains 1; policy revision 4 adds governing-Issue liveness without invalidating existing checkpoint structure.

rules: Every substantial active task has exactly one Context checkpoint section with one fenced YAML block.
All required_fields exist at the top level.
next_action appears exactly once at the top level and is a non-empty concrete scalar rather than a placeholder.
Validation result values come from allowed_validation_results.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires a concrete evidence reason.
A normalized exact fact cannot appear in more than one evidence-state list.
ROTATE is a terminal invocation result and must never be stored as task status.
Before returning ROTATE, persist task status ready, waiting or blocked with one next_action.

repository_specific_scope: Oteryn Platform context routes and architecture or documentation routing.
Delivery, merge, security, Laravel, database, and cross-repository policies outside the shared checkpoint structure.
Active-task live governing Issue, PR, branch, archive identity and terminal-transition reconciliation.
upgrade_required_when: A required checkpoint field is added, removed or changes type.
An existing status, validation result, evidence-state meaning or next_action rule is removed or changed incompatibly.
Checkpoint structure or parser behaviour changes so an existing valid version 1 checkpoint becomes invalid.
additive_revision_process: Additive accepted status or validation values may retain checkpoint version 1 when all existing checkpoints remain valid.
Increment policy_revision and synchronize Oteryn Platform documentation, machine-readable contracts, validators and tests.
External compatibility may be observed read-only; adoption in another repository requires separate owner authorization and a separate task in that repository.
Record the distinction between checkpoint task status and terminal invocation result.
Live-state policy may add governing-Issue or PR/branch liveness without changing checkpoint_version when it does not change the checkpoint structure.
upgrade_process: Inspect an external compatibility reference read-only only when it is relevant to the proposed Oteryn Platform change.
Decide whether Oteryn Platform adopts the new structural version or records an intentional divergence.
Update this marker, CONTEXT_HANDOFF.md, TASK_TEMPLATE.md, checkpoint.py and validator tests together when structure changes.
Keep repository-specific governance independent; do not mechanically synchronize complete root AGENTS.md content.
